data.name: Alpine X
data.description: Alpine X is a French deeptech startup based in Val d'Isère developing high-altitude direct air capture systems optimized for cold, dry, high-insolation Alpine conditions above 1500m. Its technology uses metal-organic framework (MOF) sorbents in modular DAC units and is currently being tested on a lab bench replicating Alpine atmospheric conditions, with a first pilot in early deployment.
